summary.false_negative_pattern: All 3 false negatives are 'subtle' errors: coarse mesh (S5), BC swap (S6), wrong viscosity (S2). These produce plausible-looking flows that require quantitative comparison to detect.
summary.visualization_feedback: Streamline rendering too dense/thin in channel flow cases (S2). Consider reducing density parameter.
